item.title: LSU urges baseball fans traveling to Alex Box Stadium to use caution due to flooding in the area
item.description: BATON ROUGE &mdash; Fans traveling to Alex Box Stadium for the LSU baseball game on Sunday are encouraged to use caution due to flooding in the area.LSU officials expect several roads around the stadium to be closed, and suggest that travelers avoid Burbank Drive and use Nicholson Drive or River Road instead.&nbsp;Parking lots around the stadium will also be closed due to flooding. item.title: Son of Iran's late supreme leader has been named his successor
item.description: Iranian state TV on Sunday said Mojtaba Khamenei, son of the country&rsquo;s late supreme leader, has been named his successor.He had long been considered a contender, even before an Israeli strike killed his father at the start of the war, and despite never being elected or appointed to a government position.Iran&rsquo;s powerful paramilitary Revolutionary Guard answers to the supreme leader, and now the younger Khamenei will have the central say in war strategy.Permalink| Comments

item.title: Car crashes into home on Keel Avenue
item.description: BATON ROUGE &mdash; A vehicle ran into a house on Keel Avenue Sunday evening, leaving a large hole in the side of the structure.&nbsp;The crash happened around 5:20 p.m. The East Baton Rouge Sheriff's Office responded to the crash.Deputies said the driver and a passenger were taken to a hospital to be evaluated, but no one inside the house waws injured.&nbsp;No information has been released.&nbsp;Permalink| Comments

item.title: Plaquemine Fire Department renames station to honor family that has served the community for over a century
item.description: PLAQUEMINE &mdash; The Plaquemine Fire Department renamed its Central Fire Station on Sunday to honor a family with a history spanning over a century with the department.&nbsp;The fire station was renamed to the Yves G. Ramirez Central Fire Station in honor of Yves G. Ramirez, who worked his way up the ranks at the Plaquemine Fire Department. item.title: Walker residents say ongoing drainage issues worsen flooding after storms
item.description: WALKER - Some residents in Livingston Parish are dealing with flooding after storms moved through the area Saturday night. Neighbors in Walker say the water left behind is part of a problem they have been facing for years.According to Entergy, more than 2,000 customers in Livingston Parish lost power during the storms. item.title: 8-year-old killed in shootout, EBRSO investigating
item.description: BATON ROUGE - An eight-year-old boy was killed in a shootout along San Juan Drive in Baton Rouge on Sunday.&nbsp;The East Baton Rouge Sheriff's Office said gunfire erupted around 6:20 p.m. People in a vehicle were reportedly shooting at others outside, who were returning fire.&nbsp;Deputies say the boy was struck by a bullet.
